rootLicenseConflict: Root LICENSE says BY-ND 4.0, while README and the more specific model-directory notice say BY-SA 4.0 and explicitly permit derivatives. Preserve all notices; do not treat the root code license as individual mesh evidence.
attribution: BodyParts3D - The Database Center for Life Science - CC-BY-SA 2.1 Japan
Z-Anatomy - The open source atlas of anatomy - CC-BY-SA 4.0
individualLicenses: Upstream does not attach separate licenses or creators per selected mesh. Selection uses the specific models notice and excludes all named NC inner-ear/kidney assets.
transformations: Baked original world matrices, including source hierarchy
Applied the exact existing muscle normalization once, common to all selected meshes
Reversed triangle winding for mirrored source transforms
Deduplicated only exactly equal Float32 position/normal/UV/color tuples
Preserved triangle order by groups, material names and available UV/color attributes
No generated geometry, shape fitting, smoothing, decimation, hole filling or independent centering
excluded: All helper marker boxes and labels (including suffix j/i assets)
All unlisted body/neck geometry and attachment markers
All inner-ear and kidney assets and their NC exceptions
All nerves, brain and eye internals except sclera/cornea/iris
No replacement MakeHuman geometry or arbitrary alignment
limitations: Generic atlas, not an individual patient, not clinical validation
Head skin is a segmented low-poly anatomical surface, not a photorealistic textured face
FBX material names/groups and available UVs exist, but parsed source materials are neutral and have no texture maps
Source seams, openings and existing triangulation remain unchanged
Eye iris has no UV attribute in source; no texture or pupil geometry is invented
Ear surface retained from Regions; all internal-ear structures excluded
Local visual/anatomical approval is still required before any integration or publication
